required_semantics: Bounded successful processes emit no stderr and preserve exact captured stdout bytes.
Cleared environment and exact ordered configuration overrides isolate admitted Git semantics.
HEAD tree and stage-zero index mode/object/path maps are exact and equal.
Repository root, revision, object format, and attributes path are resolved by closed parsers.
Version, executable, and direct ELF runtime identities remain exact before and after use.
assumptions: Cleared environment and exact overrides contain configuration for the admitted read-only commands.
The checker owns bounded capture, termination, reap, and pre/post identity verification.
The exact executable keeps rev-parse, ls-tree, and ls-files built in without helper dispatch.
The reviewed Linux x86_64 kernel, loader, filesystem, process, object, and index semantics are trustworthy.
invalidators: Any admitted command beginning to dispatch a helper, hook, pager, transport, editor, or credential process.
Any command, ordered configuration prefix, replacement environment, current-directory, bound, or parser change.
Any executable, raw version output, interpreter, direct ELF input, canonical path, digest, or size drift.
Any expansion to another command family, environment, architecture, Product consumer, or Product profile.
